$comment: Canonical Markova design tokens. This file is the single source of truth for
colour, radius, type scale and spacing across web/ and mobile/.
Never edit those two files by hand - the sync script overwrites them, and CI
fails if they drift from this file.
Every foreground/background pair below was checked against WCAG 2.1 AA:
body text >= 4.5:1, UI component boundaries >= 3:1. See scripts/check-contrast.mjs.

meta.$comment: Web carries a full dark palette: every colour below has a `dark` alongside its `value`, and the reader chooses light, dark or system. Mobile is still light-only and takes only the typeface and brand colour from here.

primary.use: Brand navy. Primary actions, active nav, headings that carry brand.

primaryLight.use: Hover/focus ring, and the fill behind a secondary button. It carries onPrimary as text there, so it is held to the text ratio as well as the 3:1 a ring needs: at #2E86C1 the secondary button was white on 3.97:1.

onPrimary.use: Text and icons on a solid primary fill. Derived per school by brandPalette, so a school whose colour is a bright yellow does not get white text on its own badges.

accentLight.use: Subtle brand wash: hover rows, info banners.

foregroundMuted.use: Secondary text that must stay strong. 7.6:1 on surface.

muted.use: Labels, captions, placeholders. AA (>=4.5:1) on every surface token, including surfaceMuted and accentLight.

border.use: Decorative dividers and card edges. Softened by master's UI pass; not contrast-checked because it never carries meaning on its own.

field.use: Inset background for form controls and read-only fields.

borderInput.use: Form control boundaries. 3.4:1 on surface - meets the 3:1 UI threshold.

success.use: Present, passed, approved, returned. 5.3:1 on surface.

warning.use: Late, pending, due soon, overdue-warning. 5.0:1 on surface.

danger.use: Absent, failed, overdue, destructive actions. 5.4:1 on surface.

info.use: Neutral informational state - deliberately the brand navy.

onSuccess.use: Text and icons on a solid success fill. White reads on the light green; on the dark palette that fill is pale, so the text goes near-black instead.

onWarning.use: Text and icons on a solid warning fill, for the same reason.

onDanger.use: Text and icons on a solid danger fill, for the same reason. This is the unread badge and the destructive button.

white.use: Literal white - text on solid fills.

chartSeries.$comment: Sequential brand ramp for single-measure charts (pie slices, stacked bars). These are FILLS, not text: give slices a white stroke so neighbouring steps stay separable.

chartCategorical.$comment: Distinct hues for unordered categories (timetable subject blocks). Every value clears 4.5:1 against white, because these carry white label text.

motion.$comment: Durations in milliseconds. Short on purpose: a teacher entering marks for forty students meets the same interaction forty times, so 250ms of flourish is ten seconds of waiting added to one task. Motion here explains a change; it never delays reading data. All of it is disabled by the prefers-reduced-motion block in globals.css.
motion.$easing: Entrances ease out so they arrive fast and settle; exits ease in so they commit.

shadow.$comment: Soft elevation scale from the UI audit: present but diffuse, blue-grey tint, never harsh.

radius.$comment: Named to match Tailwind's scale so `rounded-lg` and `radius.lg` are the same pixels. `panel` is the exception, far outside the scale: it is the floating navigation card's corner, a shape rather than a rounded rectangle, and it is paired with corner-shape: squircle.

fontSize.$comment: Matches Tailwind's default type scale exactly, in px.

spacing.$comment: 4px base scale. Tailwind equivalents in comments: xs=1, sm=2, md=3, lg=4, xl=5, 2xl=6, 3xl=8, 4xl=10, 5xl=12.

font.$comment: Web loads it via next/font; mobile loads the same family via expo-font.
font.$monoComment: Machine codes only: student IDs, NFC tags, reference numbers. Mobile loads it via expo-font; web falls back to the stack below.
